Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Jermaine O'Neal?

Jermaine O'Neal is 47 years old.

Where was Jermaine O'Neal born?

Jermaine O'Neal was born in Columbia, South Carolina.

When was Jermaine O'Neal born?

Jermaine O'Neal was born on October 13, 1978.

How tall is Jermaine O'Neal?

Jermaine O'Neal is 6-11 (211 cm) tall.

How much did Jermaine O'Neal weigh when playing?

Jermaine O'Neal weighed 226 lbs (102 kg) when playing.

Is Jermaine O'Neal in the Hall of Fame?

Jermaine O'Neal is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Jermaine O'Neal drafted?

Jermaine O'Neal was drafted by Portland Trail Blazers, 1st round (17th pick, 17th overall), 1996 NBA Draft.

What position did Jermaine O'Neal play?

Center and Power Forward.

When did Jermaine O'Neal retire?

Jermaine O'Neal last played in 2014.

What is Jermaine O'Neal's net worth?

Jermaine O'Neal made at least $168,794,021 playing professional basketball.

How much did Jermaine O'Neal make?

Jermaine O'Neal made $23,016,000 in 2010.

What did Jermaine O'Neal average?

Jermaine O'Neal averaged 13.2 points, 7.2 rebounds, and 1.4 assists per game.

How many rings does Jermaine O'Neal have?

Jermaine O'Neal won 0 championships.

What schools did Jermaine O'Neal attend?

Jermaine O'Neal attended Eau Claire in Columbia, South Carolina.

What are Jermaine O'Neal's nicknames?

J.O., The Kid, T.K. are nicknames for Jermaine O'Neal.
